Product Quality Case builder, Digital domain and Wheel loaders
We are looking for a Product Quality Case builder for the domain of Digital services and products, as well as for parts of the Wheel loader systems and components. As a case builder you will monitor the field quality situation of the domain in question and work closely with the respective Product Maintenance teams and the sales regions to drive product quality of our products.

The Case Builder supports the Product Maintenance team throughout the cases, participating in PM and TFR meetings. You will chair the cross functional Field quality meetings.
In addition, the role also includes to initiate and/or evaluate Special Commitments and analyze data for decision, calculate costs for Special Commitments and support the Service Bulletin work.
You should contribute with your competence and expertise, collaborating closely and cross functionally in your network. We strive to put people in the driver seat by building a culture that is both self- and collaboration-driven. Besides the operational responsibility, you are expected to question the status quo, look for continuous improvements in ways of working and inspire and motivate your peers.
Required competencies:
We prefer if you have a Bachelor of Science within Engineering or equivalent. Experience of the Volvo Digital Services and products and Wheel loader product line-up is required. Strong analytical skills good communication and networking capabilities complete the picture.
You are fluent in written and spoken English. Additional languages are a plus.
The location for this position is in Europe.
Ready for the next move?
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. 
Hope you are ready to be a part of building tomorrow together with us.
We look forward to your application latest at November 22.

Hiring Manager: Fredrik Borenberg, Fredrik.Borenberg@volvo.com

Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Energy Management Engineer for a specialized consulting assignment with an internationally renowned client in the automotive and sustainable mobility industry in Gothenburg, Sweden.
Are you passionate about vehicle thermal management, climate control software, and energy-efficient powertrain technologies? This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to next-generation vehicles by developing, integrating, calibrating, and validating advanced climate control functions.
We’re looking for an engineer with strong automotive thermal systems expertise, hands-on model-based development experience, and the ability to take end-to-end ownership of complex software functions.

Develop, integrate, calibrate, and verify climate control software for automotive applications.

Apply model-based development techniques and support automatic code generation using Embedded Coder.

Conduct function validation, bench testing, and road testing.
Assess system behavior against technical requirements, vehicle performance targets, and customer expectations.
Collaborate with software developers, hardware engineers, test engineers, system architects, and product teams.
Apply established software development processes and quality assurance practices.
Take end-to-end ownership of assigned climate control functions, from concept and development through validation and continuous improvement.
Evaluate emerging technologies and new control concepts to improve vehicle efficiency and thermal performance.

✅ Must-Have Skills & Qualifications
Master’s degree in Control Systems, Vehicle Engineering, Applied Physics, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
At least 5 years of relevant automotive industry experience, preferably in climate control and thermal management.
Strong domain knowledge of climate and thermal systems, including HVAC, battery cooling, and powertrain cooling.
Good understanding of control theory, including PID control and state machines.
Hands-on experience with model-based development using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow.
Experience developing and simulating control algorithms and supporting automatic code generation using Embedded Coder.
Practical experience with embedded software development in C/C++.
Experience in software calibration using INCA, CANape, or equivalent automotive tools.
Experience in function validation, test-bench activities, and vehicle road testing.
Understanding of software development processes, technical documentation, and quality assurance.
Valid B driving license and experience in vehicle testing and subjective evaluation.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

⭐ Meritorious Experience
Experience with hybrid and electric vehicle powertrain technologies.
Experience developing thermal management strategies for battery electric vehicles.
Strong background in automotive control systems and function ownership.
Experience benchmarking new technologies and evaluating alternative control strategies.
Business or management education that complements a technical engineering background.
Experience working in international, cross-functional automotive development environments.

👤 Our Ideal Candidate
You are a technically strong and analytical engineer who takes responsibility for the end-to-end performance of assigned functions.
You can translate customer needs and system requirements into effective control concepts, investigate complex technical problems, and drive solutions through development and validation.
You enjoy collaborating with software, hardware, test, and product teams and can explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Job Description
WHAT YOU'LL DO
As an Investment Associate at H&M Group's New Growth & Ventures, you will help identify, evaluate, and support investments in the companies shaping the future of fashion and customer experience. You will work across the full investment lifecycle, from sourcing and due diligence to portfolio support, combining rigorous financial analysis with an outward-facing, relationship-driven approach.

At your desk, you will dig into company financials, analyze market trends, build models, and turn complex information into clear investment recommendations.

Analyze company financials, business models, and unit economics to assess investment opportunities
Build financial models and valuations, and support due diligence processes through reviewing and analyzing investment documentation and agreements

Represent New Growth & Ventures at startup events, conferences and industry gatherings both in Sweden and globally

You will succeed in this role if you have:
A degree in finance, economics, business, engineering, or a related field

Experience conducting market research, commercial assessments, and due diligence
A natural ability to network, build relationships, and generate new leads
Energy and enthusiasm for representing the team at external events, including meetups and gatherings across the world

Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

Have you been considering a career change but have not yet found the right opportunity?
Are you looking for a position where you can work across a broad range of surgery, take responsibility, and at the same time enjoy a healthy work-life balance? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery to join a smaller acute care hospital located on a Nordic island in a unique setting. Here, you will have the opportunity to work broadly within surgery and become an important part of a close-knit clinical team.

The surgical department offers a broad scope of practice and is not divided into narrow subspecialty sections. This means you will work with a varied patient population and have the opportunity to use a wide range of your surgical skills.
The work includes gastrointestinal surgery, gallbladder and hernia surgery, colorectal surgery, proctology, endoscopy and acute surgery. Both open and laparoscopic surgery are performed.
Endoscopy is a natural part of the surgical practice and includes both gastroscopy and colonoscopy.
Working at a smaller acute care hospital means that the working day can vary considerably. You should therefore enjoy a broad surgical role and feel confident assessing and managing a range of surgical conditions.
Close collaboration and a supportive team

We are not looking for someone who is expected to know everything. What matters is that you have broad surgical competence, sound clinical judgement, and the confidence to recognise when you may need support or wish to further develop your skills in a particular area.
The smaller hospital setting also gives you the opportunity to contribute your experience and play an active role in the continued development of the department.
Work-life balance
The position is located in a unique Nordic island environment, surrounded by the sea, archipelago and nature. It offers an attractive alternative for those seeking a different lifestyle from what is often associated with working at a large regional or university hospital.
For those who value both a professionally rewarding career and time for family, leisure and recovery, the location offers an attractive combination.
Qualifications
We are looking for a specialist who:
Holds an EU-recognised specialist qualification in General Surgery
Has broad surgical competence and experience
Has experience in gastrointestinal and acute surgery
Has experience in endoscopy, particularly gastroscopy
Is comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
Has good collaboration skills and a patient-centred approach
Is flexible and appreciates the variety that comes with working at a smaller acute care hospital
Has good English language skills
Has a strong motivation to learn Swedish. Language training is provided.

Experience in additional areas of surgery is considered an advantage.

You are a Specialist in General Surgery who appreciates the breadth of the specialty and enjoys working in a smaller clinical environment where collaboration, flexibility and responsibility are a natural part of everyday work.
You are confident in your professional role, collaborative and open-minded. You value being part of a close-knit team where colleagues support one another and where your experience and expertise can make a meaningful contribution to both the department and its patients.
You are also motivated to continue developing professionally and are happy to share your own knowledge and experience with colleagues.

🏢 Department: PMO (Project Management Office)

We're looking for an OFCI Manager to join our PMO team in Stockholm and play a central role in delivering large-scale data center projects across Sweden.
In this role, you'll lead the planning, coordination, and installation readiness of Owner Furnished Contractor Installed (OFCI) equipment, ensuring critical infrastructure is delivered and installed safely, efficiently, and on schedule. Working closely with clients, suppliers, logistics partners, and construction teams, you'll help drive successful project delivery from procurement through commissioning and handover.
This position is based in Stockholm, with occasional travel to project sites as required.
What You'll Do
As OFCI Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring that owner-supplied equipment arrives where it needs to be, when it needs to be there, and is ready for installation without impacting project delivery.

Owning and maintaining the OFCI schedule, aligning equipment deliveries with construction, commissioning, and handover milestones
 

Coordinating between client procurement teams, equipment vendors, logistics partners, and installation contractors
 

Managing the OFCI register, including purchase orders, lead times, delivery schedules, storage plans, and installation status
 

Planning equipment receiving, inspections, and damage/shortage reporting processes
 

Defining installation scopes and managing interfaces between owners, suppliers, and contractors
 

Ensuring installation resources are available when equipment arrives on site
 

Tracking delays, changes, risks, and claims, and escalating issues proactively

Providing regular progress updates and reporting to project leadership and clients

Own the OFCI scope for a defined package or project site
 

Coordinate stakeholders and manage day-to-day delivery activities
 

Drive planning and execution with support on major escalations and contractual interfaces
 

Build expertise in data center delivery and critical infrastructure projects
 

Senior Level
At the senior level, you will:
Lead OFCI delivery across multiple project packages or sites
 

Establish and improve OFCI processes, standards, and reporting structures
 

Manage senior client stakeholders, key vendors, and complex project interfaces
 

Mentor colleagues and contribute to the growth of the wider PMO organization
 

Act as a trusted advisor on OFCI strategy, risk management, and execution planning

Required Qualifications
3+ years of experience in data center, critical infrastructure, industrial, or large-scale construction project delivery (intermediate level)
 

7+ years of relevant experience for senior-level candidates
 

Experience working with OFCI/CFCI procurement models and contractor interfaces

This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of Sweden's rapidly growing data center sector, delivering business-critical infrastructure for global clients. Whether you're looking to take the next step in your career or bring your senior expertise to complex mission-critical projects, you'll find challenging work, significant responsibility, and opportunities for long-term growth.

TL;DR: Most companies treat documentation as a help centre. At Lovable it's part of the product. Millions of people learn to build software from our docs, and so do the AI agents working for them: the Lovable agent suggests pages, coding tools read them, and our assistants answer from them. You'll be our second technical writer, with product areas of your own from the start and a seat at every launch, and you'll help work out something nobody has fully worked out yet: what documentation should be when its readers are people and agents, and the product changes every day.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.
We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
You've spent 3+ years documenting software products, and you can show us pages that get a reader to the outcome without re-reading.
You already write with AI: for research, drafting and checking, not just polish. You know what it gets wrong and you catch it.
You test what you document. You'd rather try the feature and read the source than take someone's word for it, and when something's broken or confusing, you say so.
You're at home in docs-as-code: Git, Markdown and pull requests.
You ask engineers and PMs specific questions, and when documenting a feature shows it won't make sense to users, you raise it early, with reasons.

Preferred:
You've shipped docs weekly at a startup or scale-up, finding out what changed yourself.
You've written for AI readers, or you're curious about it.
You have UX writing or content design experience, or an interest in it.
You can read code well enough to check how a feature actually behaves; writing code is not required.

What you'll do
Drive, don't wait. Features land every day, and bigger launches several times a month. You find out what's shipping before anyone tells you, and the docs are ready the day it ships.
Own it end to end. Work a feature out from the code and the product, write the page, verify it in Lovable, ship it, and keep it true as the product moves.
Care about the reader more than the feature. Our docs come with data: what people can't find, what the assistant couldn't answer, what support hears. You use it to decide what to write next.
Make the product better, not just explain it. Documenting a feature means using it end to end. You'll find the confusing label or the broken step and get it fixed before launch.
Write for three readers on one page. The non-technical builder, the developer, and the AI agent working on their behalf.
Build something that outlasts the week. AI drafts a lot of our pages. The human work is judgement: what a feature needs, what the engineer didn't mention, and the checks that keep hundreds of pages correct.

Where you'll start:
Enterprise. Identity and access, governance, audit, data residency: the pages a security team reads before they sign.
The developer surface. Take our API and MCP references from correct to complete.
Your first launch. Own the docs for one in your first weeks, from working group to launch day.
Your first automation. Pick one check we still do by hand and make it run on its own.

About your application
Please submit your application and your writing samples in English using the form below. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

What we do at Blykalla
Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com.

What you’ll get to do
We're seeking a Senior Thermal-Hydraulics Code Validation Engineer to join our Nuclear Engineering & Safety team, working from Stockholm or Oskarshamn. In this role, you will work on experiments with the aim of validating thermal-hydraulics system codes for use in the design and safety analysis of our lead-cooled fast reactors.

More specifically, you will
Coordinate, specify and analyze experiments to be run in our ARTS (Advanced Reactor Testing Site) facility in Oskarshamn.
Act as a technical lead for engineers and technicians working on both the experiments and the simulation codes.
Contribute to our validation program for thermal hydraulics system codes and associated methodologies.
Stay current with advances in thermal hydraulics, computational methods, and regulatory requirements.

Who you’ll get to work with
The thermal-hydraulics validation engineer sits in the Nuclear Engineering & Safety team within Blykalla, and reports to the manager of Nuclear Engineering & Safety. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and our company. You can choose to work from any of our offices in Stockholm, Oskarshamn or ARTS (at Simpevarp). In case of work from the Stockholm office, frequent (monthly) travel to the ARTS site is expected.
Who you are
You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personal chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are:
